composition_prompt: High-fidelity 3D animated feature film style. dino_bones_paleontologist_5 is working carefully on a steep badlands hillside outcrop, using a rock pick to chip away at a massive boulder of gritty, rusty tan sandstone. The iron-stained matrix material is being cleared away to isolate a heavy, mineralized T. rex jawbone complete with deep-rooted banana-shaped teeth. Blazing midday badlands sun highlights her red shorts and active pose. 1:1 Square aspect ratio.
